description: Sample in-bounds ChangeRequests for rest-api-v1 demos (mini-erp-v1). Includes feature and bugfix examples.

demos.title: Add product resource
demos.description: Add a Product resource to the mini-ERP API: POST /products (name, sku, unitPrice) creates a new product and returns 201 Created with the product including its generated id. GET /products/{id} retrieves a product by id and returns 200 OK, or 404 Not Found if the id does not exist. Persist products in an in-memory dictionary. Update openapi.yaml with the new paths and schemas. Add contract tests for both operations.

demos.title: Add customer resource
demos.description: Add a Customer resource to the mini-ERP API: POST /customers (name, email) creates a new customer and returns 201 Created with the customer including its generated id. GET /customers/{id} retrieves a customer by id and returns 200 OK, or 404 Not Found if the id does not exist. Persist customers in an in-memory dictionary. Update openapi.yaml with the new paths and schemas. Add contract tests for both operations.

demos.title: Fix health endpoint response content type in OpenAPI
demos.description: The openapi.yaml declares GET /health returns application/json, but the schema should explicitly include the 'status' property as required. Update the OpenAPI specification to ensure the response schema correctly documents the { "status": "ok" } structure with proper required fields and examples.
demos.stepsToReproduce: Review openapi.yaml - the health endpoint response schema should have 'status' as required and include an example value.
demos.expectedBehavior: OpenAPI spec shows 'status' as required string with example 'ok'.
demos.actualBehavior: Schema is minimal and could be more explicit about the response contract.
